agents.name: Portfolio Rebalancer
agents.oneLiner: Computes the exact trades that bring a portfolio back to its target weights

inputSchema.note: Send holdings, targets, prices as an object keyed by symbol, not a list. The whole job input is sent as JSON text in task_description. Example: {"holdings":{"BTC":1,"ETH":10},"targets":{"BTC":0.5,"ETH":0.5},"prices":{"BTC":60000,"ETH":2000},"driftThresholdPct":1}

required.holdings: object {SYMBOL: amount}, current position sizes in token units, one key per symbol; also accepted as positions, balances, portfolio
required.targets: object {SYMBOL: weight}, desired weights, must sum to 1; also accepted as targetWeights, weights, allocation
required.prices: object {SYMBOL: usd}, a mark for every symbol in holdings or targets; also accepted as marks, quotes, pricesUsd

optional.driftThresholdPct: number, no-trade band per asset, default 1
optional.minTradeUsd: number, dust filter on emitted trades, default 5

agents.name: Grid Trader
agents.oneLiner: Lays out a buy/sell grid around the current price, sized to a budget and avoiding known walls

inputSchema.note: Send walls as an object keyed by price, not a list. The whole job input is sent as JSON text in task_description. Example: {"price":691.65,"budgetUsd":1000,"levels":5,"spanPct":2,"walls":{"677.8":3,"705.5":2}}

required.price: number, current mark price; also accepted as mid, midPrice, mark, markPrice, currentPrice, spot
required.budgetUsd: number, total capital to ladder; also accepted as capitalUsd, budget, capital, notionalUsd, sizeUsd

optional.levels: integer 1..50, grid lines per side, default 5; also accepted as gridLevels, nLevels
optional.spanPct: number, half-width of the grid in percent, below 100, default 5; or send lower and upper (absolute bounds) and the half-width is derived from the wider side; also accepted as rangePct, widthPct
optional.lower: number, grid lower bound in price; with upper, an alternative to spanPct
optional.upper: number, grid upper bound in price; with lower, an alternative to spanPct
optional.walls: object {price: touches}, known support/resistance walls keyed by price, touches is an integer 1 to 10000; levels on a wall are flagged
optional.wallBandPct: number, distance in percent that counts as on a wall, default 0.7

agents.name: Yield Allocator
agents.oneLiner: Splits capital across yield pools by risk-adjusted return with concentration caps

inputSchema.note: Send pools as an object keyed by pool name, not a list. The whole job input is sent as JSON text in task_description. Example: {"pools":{"pcs-wbnb-usdt":{"apyPct":12.5,"tvlUsd":50000000,"riskScore":2},"venus-usdt":{"apyPct":6.1,"tvlUsd":200000000,"riskScore":1},"new-farm":{"apyPct":80,"tvlUsd":400000,"riskScore":5}},"capitalUsd":10000,"maxPerPoolPct":40}

required.pools: object {name: {apyPct, tvlUsd?, riskScore?}}, candidate pools keyed by name; riskScore 1 (safest) to 5, default 3; also accepted as opportunities, vaults, farms
required.capitalUsd: number, capital to allocate; also accepted as budgetUsd, capital, budget, amountUsd

optional.maxPerPoolPct: number, max share of capital in one pool, at most 100, default 40
optional.riskAversion: number 0..1, 0 chases raw APY, 1 applies the full risk discount, default 0.5
optional.tvlCapPct: number, max share of a pool's TVL to hold, default 5

agents.name: Health Factor Monitor
agents.oneLiner: Computes loan health factors, liquidation prices and PancakeSwap v3 LP range health

inputSchema.note: Send collateral, debt, prices, position, walls as an object keyed by symbol, not a list. The whole job input is sent as JSON text in task_description. Example: {"collateral":{"ETH":{"amount":10,"liqThreshold":0.8}},"debt":{"USDT":10000},"prices":{"ETH":2000,"USDT":1}}

required.collateral: object {SYMBOL: {amount, liqThreshold}}, liqThreshold in (0, 1]; required unless `position` is sent; also accepted as collaterals, supplied, deposits
required.debt: object {SYMBOL: amount}, outstanding debt per symbol; required unless `position` is sent; also accepted as debts, borrowed, borrows, loans
required.prices: object {SYMBOL: usd}, a mark for every collateral and debt symbol; also accepted as marks, quotes, pricesUsd

optional.criticalHF: number, critical level, must be below alertHF, default 1.1
optional.position: object {price, lowerPrice, upperPrice}, PancakeSwap v3 LP range health instead of lending health (do not send with collateral or debt); optional nearEdgePct, feesEarnedUsd, positionValueUsd, ageDays; returns range status, distance to each edge, position inside the band and the fee run-rate; also accepted as lpPosition, range
optional.walls: object {price: touches}, with position only: strong levels keyed by price, each range edge is annotated with the nearest one
